_about: Encounter-modifier fragment (List 12 #112) — modifier items expressed entirely through the #31 item layer (list4-systems/schemas/item.schema.json). Transform shapes only: ZERO items instanced (consistent with #31's zero-instance register), all parameter values null, and the repel floor's semantics are OPEN pending an owner ruling against #52's no-party-read law (Shape A relative vs Shape B fixed — see the spec).

spawn.lure._note: Matching slots' weights are multiplied at roll time. Tables on disk never change.

spawn.repel._note: Slots whose rolled band falls entirely below the floor are removed from that roll's pick.
spawn.repel.semanticsStatus: OPEN — floor is either party-relative (Shape A) or item-fixed (Shape B); owner ruling required before any repel item is instanced
